items.tr: Bir de sen söylüyorsun, sana mı kaldı
items.example: Look who's talking! You were late three times this week.
items.exampleTr: Bir de sen söylüyorsun! Bu hafta üç kez geç kaldın.
items.simple: You say this to someone who does the same bad thing.
dialogue: A: You're always so messy, Tom.
B: Look who's talking. Your room is a jungle.
items.note: Friends ve The Office'te kardeş/iş arkadaşı atışmalarında sık.

items.example: You want to rearrange my desk? Knock yourself out.
items.exampleTr: Masamı yeniden mi düzenlemek istiyorsun? Buyur, yap bakalım.
items.simple: You let someone try something, but you think it won't work.
dialogue: A: May I try fixing your computer?
B: Knock yourself out. It's already broken.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve The Big Bang Theory'de ironik izin verirken.

items.example: I said you could stay up late, so don't push your luck.
items.exampleTr: Geç yatabilirsin dedim, şansını zorlama.
items.simple: Be happy with what you got. Do not ask for more.
dialogue: A: Can I also have ice cream and a movie?
B: Don't push your luck, young man.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da anne-çocuk tartışmalarında sık.

items.tr: Başka diyecek bir şeyim yok (haklı olduğum ortada)
items.example: He just ate the whole cake alone. I rest my case.
items.exampleTr: Pastanın hepsini tek başına yedi. Daha ne diyeyim.
items.simple: You say this when what just happened shows you were right.
dialogue: A: See? He forgot our anniversary again.
B: I rest my case. He's hopeless.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory ve How I Met Your Mother'da zafer ilan ederken.

items.example: Calling that a date is a stretch, don't you think?
items.exampleTr: Buna randevu demek biraz zorlama, sence de öyle değil mi?
items.simple: Something is hard to believe because it is pushing the truth too far.
dialogue: A: So the cat stole the money?
B: That's a stretch. Cats don't use cash.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da şüpheli teorilere verilen cevap olarak sık.

items.example: Nice try, but I'm not lending you my car again.
items.exampleTr: Güzel denemeydi ama arabamı yine ödünç vermiyorum.
items.simple: You tried to trick me, but it did not work.
dialogue: A: I'll do the dishes if you give me twenty dollars.
B: Nice try. Start washing.
items.note: Hemen her sitcom'da kurnazlık yakalandığında.

items.example: You think she'll say yes? Dream on.
items.exampleTr: Evet diyeceğini mi sanıyorsun? Rüyanda görürsün.
items.simple: You want something that will never happen.
dialogue: A: One day she'll date me.
B: Dream on, buddy.
items.note: Seinfeld ve Friends tarzı laf sokmalarda.

items.example: I wasn't looking at you. Don't flatter yourself.
items.exampleTr: Sana bakmıyordum. Kendini fazla önemseme.
items.simple: Don't think you are so special. It was not about you.
dialogue: A: I bet you stayed up thinking about me.
B: Don't flatter yourself. I slept great.
items.note: The Office'te iğneleyici cevaplarda.

items.example: You have to work till six? Cry me a river.
items.exampleTr: Altıya kadar mı çalışacaksın? Yuh, çok yazık.
items.simple: You do not feel sorry for someone who complains.
dialogue: A: My coffee is too hot and my chair is hard.
B: Cry me a river. I'm on the night shift.
items.note: Modern Family ve Seinfeld'de alaycı cevap.

items.example: You want the last slice? Be my guest.
items.exampleTr: Son dilimi mi istiyorsun? Buyur, al.
items.simple: You say yes in a polite, open way. You let them do it.
dialogue: A: Do you mind if I use your phone?
B: Be my guest. It's on the table.
items.note: Friends'te kibar ya da ironik izin verirken.

items.example: Give me a break, nobody believes that story.
items.exampleTr: Yapma ya, o hikayeye kimse inanmaz.
items.simple: You can't believe what someone said. You want them to stop.
dialogue: A: I walked ten miles to school every day.
B: Give me a break. You live next door.
items.note: The Office ve Malcolm in the Middle'da sık.

items.example: You think you'd win? You wish.
items.exampleTr: Kazanacağını mı sanıyorsun? Hadi oradan.
items.simple: You say they want it, but it will never be true.
dialogue: A: I'm sure I'd beat you at chess.
B: You wish. I've never lost.
items.note: Friends ve How I Met Your Mother'da kısa laf sokma.

items.example: Just relax, he said. Easy for you to say.
items.exampleTr: Sakin ol dedi. Söylemesi kolay.
items.simple: It is not hard for you, but it is hard for me.
dialogue: A: Just stand up and give the speech.
B: Easy for you to say. You're not nervous.
items.note: Modern Family'de baba-kız tartışmalarında.

items.tr: Beni bununla yorma, ver şunu geç
items.example: Spare me the speech, I've heard it all before.
items.exampleTr: Konuşmayı bırak, hepsini daha önce duydum.
items.simple: Please don't say it. I don't want to hear it.
dialogue: A: Let me explain why I was late.
B: Spare me. I've heard every excuse.
items.note: Seinfeld ve Breaking Bad'de sıkılmış karakterlerde.

items.en: Tell it to someone who cares
items.example: You're tired? Tell it to someone who cares.
items.exampleTr: Yorgun musun? Git başkasına anlat.
items.simple: I do not care about your problem. Tell someone else.
dialogue: A: I had to wake up at seven today.
B: Tell it to someone who cares.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve The Office'te sert espri.

items.example: Where did that come from? You never talk like that.
items.exampleTr: Bu da nereden çıktı? Hiç böyle konuşmazdın.
items.simple: You are surprised. You did not expect it.
dialogue: A: I think we should move to Alaska.
B: Where did that come from? You hate snow.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory'de beklenmedik cümlelerden sonra.

items.example: Nice save! She almost found out about the party.
items.exampleTr: İyi toparladın! Neredeyse partiyi öğrenecekti.
items.simple: You fixed a mistake just in time.
dialogue: A: I said it's a surprise gift for, um, the neighbour.
B: Nice save. She believed you.
items.note: Friends ve HIMYM'de yalanı son anda kurtarırken.

items.example: Touché. I guess I did start the argument.
items.exampleTr: Haklısın. Tartışmayı ben başlattım galiba.
items.simple: You say it when someone makes a smart point against you.
dialogue: A: You complain about noise, but you play drums.
B: Touché. Fair point.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory ve Modern Family'de nükteli itiraf.

items.tr: Ne var yani, önemli mi sanki
items.example: I'm late. Big deal, the show hasn't started.
items.exampleTr: Geciktim. Ne var yani, gösteri başlamadı.
items.simple: You say it is not important at all.
dialogue: A: You got a B on the test.
B: Big deal. It's only one test.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da ergen tepkisi olarak sık.

items.example: Zip it, Dave, I'm trying to hear this.
items.exampleTr: Çeneni kapa Dave, bunu dinlemeye çalışıyorum.
items.simple: Be quiet right now. Close your mouth like a zip.
dialogue: A: But I just wanted to say one thing.
B: Zip it. The movie's starting.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Malcolm in the Middle'da.

items.example: You've talked for ten minutes. What's your point?
items.exampleTr: On dakikadır konuşuyorsun. Ne demek istiyorsun?
items.simple: You want them to say the main thing they mean.
dialogue: A: Pizza is round, the box is square, and...
B: What's your point? I'm hungry.
items.note: The Office toplantılarında sık.

items.example: Me, sing in public? Not on your life.
items.exampleTr: Ben, herkesin içinde şarkı mı söyleyeyim? Asla.
items.simple: You say a strong no. It will never happen.
dialogue: A: Will you wear the chicken costume?
B: Not on your life.
items.note: Seinfeld'de kesin ret.

items.example: Says who? I never agreed to that.
items.exampleTr: Kim demiş? Ben buna hiç evet demedim.
items.simple: You ask who said so. You think they are wrong.
dialogue: A: You have to go to bed at nine.
B: Says who? It's a Saturday.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da inatlaşırken.

items.example: You're a pain. Right back at you.
items.exampleTr: Baş belasısın. Sana da.
items.simple: You say the same thing to the other person.
dialogue: A: You're the worst roommate ever.
B: Right back at you.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da iğneleme-karşı iğneleme.

items.en: Let's not get ahead of ourselves
items.example: We've met twice. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
items.exampleTr: İki kere görüştük. Acele etmeyelim.
items.simple: Slow down. We have not done the first steps yet.
dialogue: A: Should we name our future kids now?
B: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory'de fazla heyecanlanan karaktere.

items.tr: Yardımın için sağ ol (hiçbir işe yaramadın)
items.example: You left me alone with him? Thanks for nothing.
items.exampleTr: Beni onunla yalnız mı bıraktın? Sağ ol, çok yardım ettin.
items.simple: You say this when someone did not help at all.
dialogue: A: I stayed quiet like you asked.
B: Thanks for nothing. They caught me anyway.
items.note: Friends ve Seinfeld'de alaycı teşekkür.
